proposal.why: Memory-as-a-Service (MaaS) 正迅速成为AI Agent架构的关键支柱，它把上下文工程从一次性设计转变为持续演化的系统能力。与当前词“Context Engineering”互补，MaaS强调持久化与跨会话记忆，解决Agent长期部署中的核心痛点。多家平台已开始提供MaaS方案，表明其已从概念走向工程实践，具有明确的行业热度与落地价值。

evidence.title: Memory as a Service: The Next Frontier in AI Infrastructure
evidence.claim: Memory-as-a-Service platforms are emerging to provide persistent, context-aware memory layers for AI agents, reducing the need for repeated context engineering.

evidence.title: Why AI Needs a Memory Layer (and How to Build One)
evidence.claim: A dedicated memory layer enables agents to maintain long-term user context, a key complement to context engineering techniques.

candidates.notes: Rising as a natural extension of context engineering, focusing on persistence and retrieval.

evidence.title: Context Caching: Cutting Costs and Latency in LLM Applications
evidence.claim: Context caching is becoming a standard optimization for repeated prompts, directly impacting context engineering efficiency.

evidence.title: Anthropic's Prompt Caching: A Game Changer for Production AI
evidence.claim: Prompt caching reduces cost and latency by up to 90%, making context engineering more feasible at scale.

candidates.notes: Directly related to context engineering but distinct as an infrastructure optimization.

evidence.title: Designing Agentic Context Loops for Autonomous Workflows
evidence.claim: Agentic context loops enable agents to iteratively refine their own context, moving beyond static context engineering.

evidence.title: The Rise of Self-Improving Agents: Context Loops in Practice
evidence.claim: Context loops are a new pattern where agents update their context based on outcomes, improving long-term performance.

candidates.notes: An advanced evolution of context engineering, emphasizing dynamic adaptation.

evidence.title: RAG 2.0: Beyond Simple Retrieval to Context-Aware Generation
evidence.claim: RAG 2.0 integrates context engineering principles, enabling richer and more relevant responses.

evidence.title: The Future of RAG: How Context Engineering is Reshaping Retrieval
evidence.claim: RAG systems are increasingly relying on context engineering to improve retrieval quality and answer accuracy.

candidates.notes: While RAG is established, RAG 2.0 is a hot evolution that builds on context engineering.

evidence.title: Contextual Compression: Efficient Context Engineering for Long Conversations
evidence.claim: Contextual compression techniques reduce token usage while preserving key information, a critical complement to context engineering.

evidence.title: How to Compress Context Without Losing Meaning
evidence.claim: New compression methods allow agents to maintain longer context windows, reducing the need for manual context engineering.

candidates.notes: A technical solution to context limits, gaining traction in agent design.
